What we build

Three repos make one system. The item API and the item web pages are a small inventory app. pr-triage is a GitHub App on AWS that reviews every PR in the app repos: it checks the ticket and the policy, waits for CI, runs the expected behavior, asks an AI model for a review, and then decides in code. bash server.log & curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/items/42]]> Item web pages (Node 22) bash

Open http://localhost:5173/index.html. src/config.js already points at the local API on port 8080.

Your first week

  1. Read and .
  2. Pick a small ticket with status todo from demo-inventory-api/tickets/.
  3. Open a PR and read what pr-triage says about it before you ask a person.
  4. Read the once, so you know they exist before you need them.

The seed data is the same in every environment: items 41, 42 and 43. Item 43 has no stock, so it is the quickest way to see the sold-out case.
